name: Pack and thumbnail glance tester
why: Scores a pack image with a three-second glance test beside rivals; pairs with the front-panel thumbnail test.

name: Product brand sheet planner
why: Plans a one-page visual sheet for a product, useful before a pack design starts.

name: Unboxing card and note planner
why: Plans the card, note and gift in each parcel with wording and cost per order.

name: Unboxing insert and gift planner
why: Plans what goes inside the box from order value and margin.

name: Plan a branded unboxing that customers film and reorder for
why: A fuller unboxing plan that the insert card prompt can feed into.

name: Sensory unboxing planner
why: Picks one cue each for weight, colour, sound, smell and feel, with cost per order.

name: Product sample approval loop
why: Checks factory samples against a tech pack; the same discipline applies to printed pack samples.

name: Supplier quote request writer
why: Writes a quote request in maker terms; useful when asking packaging suppliers for prices.

name: Launch critical path builder
why: Dates every step back from launch day, including pack proofs and print lead times.

name: Claim evidence checker
why: Matches each claim to its proof before it goes on a pack.

name: Brand guide builder
why: Turns brand files into a guide with colour and type values a pack designer needs.
